title: What would make an AI investing tool actually trustworthy to you?
author: seviniryusuf
selftext:
I build an investing education app that uses AI to explain stocks in plain English. The pushback I hear most is about trust: people can't tell what the AI is basing things on, or whether it's just confidently wrong.

So what would an AI tool need to show you before you'd take it seriously? Sources for every claim? A track record? The raw numbers behind a score? Something else?

And what's the most annoying thing current AI finance tools do?

Mine doesn't give buy or sell calls and I want to keep it that way, so I'm mostly interested in the explaining side. I'll share what I change based on this.
